products.product_description: Country Harvest brand Black Thunder Bean Soup, dried soup mix is packaged in poly pro bag, heat sealed and placed in another poly pro bag & tape sealed. Net. 8 oz. UPC 7 29818 00104 6. The label is read in parts" ***For That Home Cooked Goodness***Country HARVEST ***BLACK THUNDER BEAN SOUP***INGREDIENTS***Blackbeans, onion, chicken soup base (salt, maltodextrine, dextrose, dairy whey***".
products.reason_for_recall: Country Harvest brand Black Thunder Bean Soup is recalled because the ingredients statement declared Dairy Whey but did not declare milk.
